verdict.rationale: Segment's own docs show event-driven rules in two places. Engage Audiences are conditions built from tracking events and traits that sync automatically to destinations. Segment combined with Messaging sends messages automatically based on real-time events. However, the evidence never describes a general rule builder with explicit trigger, condition and action steps, and Functions are only a JavaScript building block. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose trigger/condition/action rule engine, detail on configuring event-triggered actions beyond audience syncs and messaging, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Combine Segment with Messaging to send messages automatically based on real-time events without managing complex integrations.
You can build Audiences from core tracking events, traits, and computed traits. You can then sync Audiences to hundreds of Destinations
Destinations allow you to act on your data and learn more about your customers in real time.
